items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: When I was with Brobby Rastus, that's the same show that Bessie Smith was on.

ctx.x: Well, now, the last show, the last minstrel show I was with was, I think that was in 1937. When I was with Brobby Rastus, that's the same show that Bessie Smith was on.
